Close-up, well-lit photo of the full part number / OEM code on the Valeo label
Close-up photo of the crack/seam line on the housing to confirm if it's a factory seam or damage

response.reason: The witness confirms a Valeo alternator consistent with the seller's claim, but functional, origin, and part-number claims remain unverified or unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst case (untested, unconfirmed fitment) pending the listed proofs.
